text: Selector form 5 ('object-qualified') keys only on the routine segment after the last '::' and ignores the object, so a header copied as a selector ('Codeunit X::Persist') can resolve to another object's routine or report ambiguity.

text: Owners use the raw IR object name, which keeps a quoted name's inner '""' escapes, so a name with embedded quotes shows doubled quotes.
